readerCopy.body: The instructions reach the people doing the work before urgency turns into confusion. Mercury trine Mars can make speaking and acting reinforce each other, especially when tasks are named, responsibilities are divided, and nobody has to translate a vague order while the deadline keeps closing in. This is useful speed because the message is precise enough to move on. Keep the directions short. Name who owns the first action, what done looks like, and when the next handoff happens.
